breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained two conflicting instructions for the time integration method: 'Explicit forward Euler' and a 'semi-implicit spectral step'. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent failed to resolve this conflict and instead included both contradictory instructions in its output: 'Use explicit forward Euler time integration' and 'Apply semi-implicit spectral method in Fourier space'.
